```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(StereoMorph)
library(geomorph)
library(abind)
```

## Question 1: Create Landmark Reference

```{r}
lm_ref <- c("1_snout",
            "2_dorsal_tip",
            "3_caudal_tip",
            "4_pelvic_tip",
            "5_pectoral_tip")
```

## Question 2: Create Landmark Directory

```{r}
dir.create("wcr_landmarks", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Question 3: Digitize Shark Landmarks

```{r digitize, eval=FALSE}
digitizeImages(image.file = "wcr_images",
               shapes.file = "wcr_landmarks", 
               landmarks.ref = lm_ref, 
               landmark.color.blur = "cyan", #colors for easy viewing.
               landmark.color.focus = "yellow", 
               control.point.color.blur = "orchid", 
               control.point.color.focus = "hotpink",
                landmark.radius = 5)
```

## Question 4: Read Landmark Files

```{r}
sm_lms <- readShapes("wcr_landmarks")
```

## Question 5: Convert to Geomorph Array

```{r}
gm_lms <- readland.shapes(sm_lms)
```

## Question 6: Procrustes Alignment

```{r}
gpa <- gpagen(gm_lms)
```

## Question 7: Principal Components Analysis

```{r}
pca <- gm.prcomp(gpa$coords)
```

## Question 8: Plot PCA

```{r}
plot(pca, axis1 = 1, axis2 = 2)
```
